question: BMGC is related to GRDZ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, LWAW is related to QBXT. To which of the following is VGUQ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

BMGC is related to GRDZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f41eb6407ae8d1d72f84655f17c7071fba67b4115fad6822e6ea0ecc0709bb46.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc992b9df5fb20b2af43a783a5ae715f0c668dc1ae1d5286ad714d042ad1af58.png] 

And,

LWAW is related to QBXT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76fa0be7ddea15089251861dd154c55f0d982dc9d9b26a181ab898124e5d7eb2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67871a94420478d97ffee18f1b60adadbe8b0a7f42f9440cb56f1be2a01cdbe4.png] 

Similarly,

VGUQ is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b067676cc22d81c4cb602bc2d94351a517a99f77451150174b7b944cdc4518c1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/446e07cf51b78b031bb8daf1596f2cd615e8e73334df6a543b56f3d4bb04b193.png] 

Thus, VGUQ is related to ALRN.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
